## Submission

The description must identify each new package version or deprecation change and its public archive URL.

## Requirements

- [ ] The submission was generated from the exact release archive with `dspm repo create`.
- [ ] Package data changes are separate from tool, schema, policy, and workflow changes.
- [ ] Historical manifests and assets are unchanged except for permitted deprecation state and reason changes.
- [ ] The publisher has distribution rights for the package and documentation.
